sources.title: UPI pricing: population-specific memberships, individual purchases and transcript charges
UPI TESU student pricing and direct transcript request alternatives

findings: General membership is explicitly limited to US citizens, permanent residents, military or partner-university students; eligibility is not inferred from a proposed degree.
TESU $89 monthly pricing is for TESU students; selecting TESU as a target does not establish current enrollment or pricing eligibility.

General $250 individual-course and discounted multi-course bundles are presented within international-student pricing. Do not apply a generic $250 course price to every source-course version or learner.
Provider lists a $20 official transcript request and TESU page also describes $25 unlimited requests. Which transcript route is required and already paid is not established for every learner.

Exact current provider course pages were independently reviewed. Each activated quote retains its original ACE course identifier, version, credits, recommendation period and separately published paid purchase; quote mismatches remain unpriced.

Each of 22 exact current course pages independently offers a paid standalone purchase with its ACE identifier and recommendation period. The visible purchase is separate from eligibility-limited US/partner memberships. Only these source-course/version/original-unit quotes are activated; the course-page marketing credit total does not replace independent ACE original credits.
